description: This file defines a class ImportViewError that handles the display logic for an error page in the import process of SuiteCRM. It manages user interface elements, module permissions, and error messaging within the import error context.

classes.name: ImportViewError
classes.description: A view class that manages rendering of the import error page, including menu generation, module tab determination, and display logic.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to generate and customize the menu for the import error view, adjusting language settings based on the selected module.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Determines which module tab the current import belongs to, defaulting to 'Home' if no specific tab is found.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Validates input parameters, assigns variables to the template engine, and renders the error template for the import error page.
